newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia has primary budget surplus in September.
newsitem.headline: Russia has primary budget surplus in September.

text.p: Russia had a primary budget surplus in September, with revenues exceeding expenditure for the first time since the Soviet Union collapsed, finance ministry figures show.
The primary budget, which excludes interest payments, showed a two trillion rouble surplus for the month.
Official figures showed that Russia spent 11.2 trillion roubles in interest payments in September, leading to an overall deficit of 9.2 trillion roubles, or 3.8 percent of gross doemstic product.
"It shows that they have been cutting expenditure very seriously to meet IMF budget targets," said one economist.
An IMF mission is in Moscow this week to work out whether to recommend handing over the latest monthly tranche in a $10 billion three-year loan.
